issue_request: FHIR-31481 was an Applied/Persuasive BRR clarification requesting that SubstanceDefinition.version describe a business-level edition or revision identifier and that SubstanceDefinition.domain describe the applicable usage of the substance, with human or veterinary only as examples.
initial_application: Git commit d96304345bcdde00400edbac0a77762cacca2580 explicitly applied FHIR-31481 to source/substancedefinition/structuredefinition-SubstanceDefinition.xml, updating the SubstanceDefinition.version and SubstanceDefinition.domain short and definition text. The parallel SubstanceDefinition-domain SearchParameter description still retained the old human/veterinary-only wording.
additional_context: SubstanceDefinition is active in source/fhir.ini, and the edited search parameter bundle is in the active SubstanceDefinition resource source folder. Jira search found only the seed issue for the issue-key query, and Zulip/Confluence searches found no relevant discussion or conflicting decision.
reconciliation: Changed source/substancedefinition/bundle-SubstanceDefinition-search-params.xml so the SubstanceDefinition-domain SearchParameter description now says "The applicable usage of the substance, as an example human or veterinary".
source_changes: source/substancedefinition/bundle-SubstanceDefinition-search-params.xml: changed the SubstanceDefinition-domain SearchParameter description from the old human/veterinary-only wording to the applied FHIR-31481 domain wording.
